summary: This tutorial explains how to print presentations in LibreOffice Impress, using GNU Linux as the operating system and version 334 of LibreOffice. To print slides, you can click on the "Print" button or use Ctrl+P. General settings include options like printing slides, handouts, notes, and outlines. You can choose to print slides in color or grayscale, and select the layout such as fitting slides to a printable page. For handouts, you can choose to print multiple slides per page. Notes can also be printed, but the size options are limited since they depend on the number of slides per page. The tutorial covers various print options, including customizing slide colors and sizes, and provides a preview of the print output. Finally, it guides users through the process of configuring their printer and initiating the print job.
